snippet.title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Official Cinematic Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The Empire is calling, Governor!
Step into the sandals of a Roman governor and build your legacy in Anno 117: Pax Romana. Your provinces await your command. Are you ready, Governor?
 
Anno 117: Pax Romana is available November 13, 2025 📜

Pre-order now 👉 https://ubi.li/2JXoZ
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274580/Anno_117_Pax_Romana/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/anno-117-pax-romana/9NFMQ8MP7353/0017
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/anno-117-pax-romana--gold-edition
PS: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011009

FOLLOW US ON:
Web: anno-union.com
Instagram: @annogame 
Facebook: facebook.com/annogame/
Twitter: twitter.com/ANNO_EN

#Anno117PaxRomana #Anno117 #Anno #Anno117Preorder

About Anno 117: Pax Romana:

In the latest instalment of the award-winning Anno strategy franchise, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? 
The cost of peace is yours to decide.

About Ubisoft:
Ubisoft is a creator of worlds, committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable entertainment experiences. Ubisoft’s global teams create and develop a deep and diverse portfolio of games, featuring brands such as Assassin’s Creed®, Brawlhalla®, For Honor®, Far Cry®, Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon®, Just Dance®, Rabbids®, Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six®, The Crew® and Tom Clancy’s The Division®. Through Ubisoft Connect, players can enjoy an ecosystem of services to enhance their gaming experience, get rewards and connect with friends across platforms. With Ubisoft+, the subscription service, they can access a growing catalog of more than 100 Ubisoft games and DLC. For the 2023-24 fiscal year, Ubisoft generated net bookings of €2.32 billion. To learn more, please visit: www.ubisoftgroup.com.
